description: Our goal is to develop an innovative, fabrication-ready semiconductor architecture using real NASA datasets to solve challenges in space exploration. We're looking for teammates skilled in AI, aerospace engineering, data science, and hardware design who want to build something truly groundbreaking.
summary: We are a team of passionate innovators combining semiconductor engineering, software development, and space technology. Through FIRECORE-X, we aim to create faster, smarter, and more efficient solutions for satellite data processing and Earth observation.
details:
FIRECORE-X is a custom semiconductor chip designed to process satellite thermal data and identify unusual heat activity.

Using 8 parallel processing lanes, our chip achieves nearly 25 times faster processing than our original design and reduces output data by over 99%. We validated it using real NOAA-20 satellite data, processing 9.8 million pixels with zero errors against our software reference.

We developed the chip using SystemVerilog, Python, C++, Verilator, Yosys, OpenROAD, and SKY130HD, completing its design from code to a verified GDSII layout.

Our project also includes an interactive NASA MODIS–VIIRS fire-activity calendar. By combining semiconductor engineering with satellite data, FIRECORE-X explores faster, more efficient Earth observation and environmental monitoring.
